description: REIT balance-sheet skeleton for SIC 6798 retaining all 270 supplied unique US GAAP concepts once. The supplied Realty Income reference guides presentation; both property-owning and mortgage-investment REIT concepts retain distinct roles and measurement scopes. Hierarchy prescribes no arithmetic or issuer-specific completeness.
classification_notes: All 270 supplied concepts appear once; the SIC inventory covers multiple REIT business models and is not a claim that Realty Income reports every concept.
The reference guides broad presentation only. Its banks investment caption is not adopted as a REIT accounting category; zeros, dashes and net debt do not establish taxonomy mappings or calculations.
Property-owning, mortgage-investment and lessee/lessor roles remain distinct. Gross, net, cost and fair-value measures and maturity/instrument axes can overlap.
Primary carrying amounts are instant monetary facts. Shares, partnership units, per-share values and two duration percentage concepts are supplemental.
No current/noncurrent maturity is inferred for unspecified concepts; explicit classified subtotals and narrower maturity tags remain available as overlapping views.

Net property, intangibles and receivables already include corresponding valuation deductions. Contra marks identified accumulated depreciation/amortization, credit allowances and treasury cost without prescribing fact-sign inversion.
Debt costs and discounts may be embedded in net borrowing amounts rather than separately recognized assets. Candidate finance-cost assets require financing-arrangement review.
Below-market and favorable acquired leases require lessor/lessee role review; net lease balances must not be amortized a second time.

Joint-venture investments owned by the REIT differ from noncontrolling equity in consolidated subsidiaries. Redeemable interests are outside permanent equity only when the applicable classification supports it.
Fair-value alternatives, Schedule III property, acquisition-date intangible recognition, contractual redemption/collateral amounts and cumulative distributions remain supplemental.

Every group explains its general scope and overlap. Review reasons identify concept-specific unresolved matters; proposed mappings still require issuer fact, unit, dimension and reporting-scope checks.

metadata_contract.period_type: Verified against official US GAAP 2026: 268 instant concepts and 2 duration percentages.
metadata_contract.unit_type: Verified 250 monetary, 13 shares/units, 5 per-share and 2 percentage concepts. Source currency and scale remain in facts.
metadata_contract.contra: True for identified accumulated depreciation/amortization, credit allowances and treasury cost. Net debt-cost premiums/discounts and distribution deficits require context rather than a universal sign.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 270 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts for SIC 6798.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

children.label: Cash, restricted balances and deposits
children.classification_note: Cash is included in cash/equivalents; restricted balances can overlap escrow and collateral. Preserve explicit current scope and establish whether restrictions are included in issuer cash totals.

children.label: Unrestricted cash
children.classification_note: Cash-only and cash-plus-equivalents are alternatives with overlapping scope.

children.label: Restricted cash balances
children.classification_note: Current cash and current cash/equivalents are subsets of unspecified-maturity restricted balances; no maturity is inferred for broader tags.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalents
concepts.review_reason: This restricted cash-plus-equivalents amount has no explicit current maturity and includes the separately mapped current cash/equivalent and cash-only subsets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue
concepts.review_reason: The official definition restricts this restricted cash/equivalents carrying value to current balances, unlike the otherwise similar unrestricted-maturity restricted cash tag.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current restricted cash is included in all-period restricted cash and may be included in current restricted cash plus equivalents.

children.label: Escrow, reserves and deposits paid
children.classification_note: Escrow excludes replacement reserve escrow under the definition. Restricted cash, deposits and collateral can describe the same underlying funds; deposits paid differ from tenant deposits received.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EscrowDeposit
concepts.review_reason: Escrow deposits exclude replacement reserves but may be included in restricted cash or other deposits; determine whether escrow is cash and avoid duplicating its funding source.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ReplacementReserveEscrow
concepts.review_reason: Replacement reserves are excluded from EscrowDeposit but may already be included in restricted cash; identify the form and avoid adding the same reserve cash twice.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepositsAssets
concepts.review_reason: Deposits transferred to third parties are assets, not tenant security deposits received; they may include escrow or other restricted balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCollateralForBorrowedSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Restricted cash collateral for borrowed securities may already be included in restricted cash or cash collateral disclosures; identify the lending/borrowing role.

children.label: Investment property and development
children.classification_note: Investment real estate, broader real-estate investments and productive-use PP&E can overlap; classify by the actual property population rather than reference presentation aggregation labels.

children.label: Reported real estate measures
children.classification_note: Net real-estate investments can include joint ventures beyond investment property. Gross carrying, cost and net amounts are measurement alternatives, not additive assets.

children.label: Net real estate investments including joint ventures

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Net real-estate investments can include joint ventures beyond net investment property; reconcile the broader aggregate and do not add its joint-venture details again.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAtCost
concepts.review_reason: Property at cost overlaps the alternative gross carrying amount and its land/building/development details; reconcile included property classes before using a gross/net bridge.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateGrossAtCarryingValue
concepts.review_reason: This investment-real-estate gross carrying amount overlaps the property-at-cost measure; establish portfolio and cost-basis coverage before selecting the gross balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RentalProperties
concepts.review_reason: Rental properties can be included in net/gross investment property and do not alone establish the same depreciation basis as those aggregates.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentsOther
concepts.review_reason: Other investment real estate excludes business-occupied and inventory property but can be contained in total net real-estate investments.

children.label: Real estate valuation deductions
children.classification_note: The two investment-property depreciation concepts may describe the same allowance. Foreclosed property depreciation is a portfolio view; none is deducted again from a net balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciation
concepts.review_reason: This real-estate accumulated depreciation can overlap the separately supplied investment-property accumulated depreciation; match the gross asset population and avoid deducting it from net property.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAccumulatedDepreciation
concepts.review_reason: Investment-property accumulated depreciation may duplicate RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciation for the same assets; select the matching allowance once.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedAccumulatedDepreciation
concepts.review_reason: REO depreciation relates to foreclosed property and may be included in broader investment-property depreciation; do not apply it to a carrying amount already net.

children.label: Land, investment buildings and development
children.classification_note: Land, investment buildings, development and tenant improvements can already be included in gross investment-property totals; component carrying bases require reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentBuildingAndBuildingImprovements
concepts.review_reason: Investment buildings and improvements can be included in property-at-cost or gross real estate; establish whether the reported carrying detail is before or after depreciation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DevelopmentInProcess
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate development-in-process may be included in gross investment property or construction in progress; classify as current only if the reported concept/context supports it.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TenantImprovements
concepts.review_reason: Tenant improvements can be included in investment-property cost or PP&E; determine gross/net carrying basis and whether lessor-owned improvements or tenant incentives are reported.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateAcquiredThroughForeclosure
concepts.review_reason: Foreclosed real estate can be included in investment property, held-for-sale assets or other assets; verify issuer measurement and presentation before treating it as a distinct portfolio.

children.label: Held-for-sale assets and disposal groups
children.classification_note: Real estate and assets outside disposal groups differ from all-group assets. Maturity and residual views overlap their aggregates; inventory property is separate.

children.label: Property and assets held for sale
children.classification_note: Land or real estate held for sale can be included in broader outside-group assets. Current outside-group assets are a subset of all-period amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateHeldforsale
concepts.review_reason: This land/building held-for-sale amount excludes real estate inventory and can overlap broader held-for-sale asset and disposal-group balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LandAvailableForSale
concepts.review_reason: Land available for sale can be contained in real-estate held-for-sale or investment property aggregates; verify investment versus inventory presentation.

children.label: Assets Held For Sale Not Part Of Disposal Group
Assets held for sale not part of disposal group current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current assets held for sale outside a disposal group are included in the all-period outside-group amount and may include real estate separately mapped.

children.label: Disposal-group asset balances
children.classification_note: Disposal-group assets include current, noncurrent and other-asset subsets. The caption does not prove all amounts are discontinued operations.

children.label: Assets Of Disposal Group Including Discontinued Operation
Assets of disposal group including discontinued operation current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetsOfDisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current disposal-group assets are a subset of all-period disposal assets and may overlap current assets held for sale outside a group only if reporting scopes are confused.

children.label: Disposal group including discontinued operation assets noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationAssetsNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent disposal-group assets are a maturity subset of all-period disposal assets and can include separately mapped investment real estate.

children.label: Disposal group including discontinued operation other assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other disposal-group assets are included in the broader disposal-group asset total and may cross maturity buckets; do not add them to that total.

children.label: Lease assets and deferred leasing costs
children.classification_note: Lessor lease receivables, acquired lease intangibles and lessee ROU assets represent different accounting roles. Reconcile broader intangible/deferred-cost totals before addition.

children.label: Acquired lease assets
children.classification_note: In-place lease assets exclude market-rate adjustments. Favorable lease gross assets depend on reporting role and can be included in finite-lived intangibles.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetAcquiredInPlaceLeases
concepts.review_reason: Acquired in-place leases exclude above/below-market adjustments and may include tenant relationships; establish remaining carrying basis and inclusion in finite-lived intangibles.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetOffMarketLeaseFavorableGross
concepts.review_reason: Favorable acquired lease assets depend on lessor/lessee role and can overlap in-place and broader finite-lived intangibles; the tag is gross and must not be treated as a net balance.

children.label: Deferred leasing costs and incentives
children.classification_note: Net initial direct costs already deduct amortization. Incentives may be embedded in receivables or the underlying asset and can overlap tenant improvements.

children.label: Deferred initial direct leasing costs, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCostsLeasingNet
concepts.review_reason: Net deferred initial direct leasing costs can be included in other deferred costs or lease asset balances; accumulated amortization must not be deducted again.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCostsLeasingAccumulatedAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Accumulated amortization of leasing costs can be included in broader finite-lived amortization; match the gross leasing cost scope and do not deduct it again from net costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncentiveToLessee
concepts.review_reason: A lessor incentive to a lessee can be incorporated in the lease receivable or underlying leased asset measurement; verify asset recognition and overlap with tenant improvements.

children.label: Lessor lease receivables
children.classification_note: Deferred rent is recognized income above contractual payments; direct-financing lease net investment is before allowance and is not an ordinary trade or mortgage receivable.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredRentReceivablesNet
concepts.review_reason: Deferred rent receivables represent recognized rental income above required payments and may be included in reported receivable totals; establish inclusion before separate presentation.

children.label: Direct-financing-lease net investment before credit allowance

concepts.name: us-gaap:DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease
concepts.review_reason: The official direct-financing-lease net investment is before allowance for credit loss and excludes ordinary mortgage/financing receivables; match any allowance only with proven scope.

children.label: Lessee right-of-use assets
children.classification_note: Operating and finance lease ROU assets are lessee balances. Gross finance ROU and net finance ROU are alternative measurement levels.

children.label: Finance Lease Right Of Use Asset
Finance lease ROU asset before amortization

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetBeforeAccumulatedAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Finance-lease ROU assets before accumulated amortization overlap net finance-lease ROU assets; the supplied universe does not provide a separate matching amortization amount.

children.label: Trade, contract and other receivables
children.classification_note: Combined trade-and-financing receivables overlap separate net trade and note balances. Lease rent, interest and customer-contract assets have distinct recognition scopes.

children.label: Receivable aggregates and trade balances
children.classification_note: All-period accounts/notes totals include narrower trade, note and current scopes; do not add totals and components or deduct allowances from already net amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsAndNotesReceivableNet
concepts.review_reason: Net accounts-and-notes receivables includes both trade and financing assets and overlaps their separate net balances; do not combine aggregate and components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsReceivableNet
concepts.review_reason: Net trade receivables can include tenant balances and may be included in accounts-and-notes receivables; do not add overlapping net balances or deduct allowances again.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsReceivableNetCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current net trade receivables are included in the unspecified-maturity net trade amount when both cover the same reporting entity.

children.label: Current notes and loans receivable, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:NotesAndLoansReceivableNetCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current net notes/loans are a maturity subset of financing receivables and can be included in broader accounts-and-notes receivables.

children.label: Other receivable balances
children.classification_note: Investment income includes interest and rents; other nontrade receivables may already be contained in broader receivable totals. Conditional contract assets differ from lease rent.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccruedInvestmentIncomeReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Accrued investment income includes interest, dividends, rents and ancillary revenues and can overlap standalone interest and rental receivables.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Other nontrade receivables may be included in accounts-and-notes or other-asset aggregates; identify exclusions for interest and financing portfolios.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerAssetNet
concepts.review_reason: Net customer contract assets are conditional rights to consideration, unlike unconditional trade or deferred lease rent receivables; do not combine overlapping presentation aggregates.

children.label: Trade receivable allowances
children.classification_note: Current allowances and premium/other-receivable allowances can overlap general trade allowances; match the gross portfolio before using a deduction.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivable
concepts.review_reason: The general trade-receivable allowance may include tenant receivables and overlap current or premium/other-receivable allowances; match portfolio before applying to gross assets.

children.label: Allowance for doubtful accounts receivable current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivableCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current trade allowances are a maturity subset of general receivable allowances; match to gross current receivables and avoid a second deduction from net amounts.

children.label: Allowance For Doubtful Accounts Premiums And Other Receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsPremiumsAndOtherReceivables
concepts.review_reason: This allowance covers premium and other receivables, potentially outside tenant/trade receivables; identify REIT-specific use before matching it to a gross balance.

children.label: Mortgage and financing investments
children.classification_note: The universe includes mortgage REITs as well as property-owning REITs. Mortgage, notes and other financing balances overlap by portfolio and accrued-interest/allowance basis.

children.label: Mortgage investment balances
children.classification_note: The generic real-estate mortgage balance does not establish the same net reserve basis as commercial/consumer mortgage loans.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: The real-estate mortgage investment definition does not specify allowance or accrued-interest treatment; reconcile it with the explicitly net commercial/consumer mortgage balance.

children.label: Commercial and consumer mortgage loans, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstateCommercialAndConsumerNet
concepts.review_reason: Commercial/consumer mortgage loans are after loan reserves and can overlap unspecified-basis mortgage investments and broader financing receivables.

children.label: Financing receivable measurements
children.classification_note: Notes gross/net and interest-excluding gross/net pairs differ in scope. Both exclude lease net investments under the official definitions; do not substitute lease assets.

children.label: Financing receivables before allowance, excluding interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: Gross financing receivables here exclude accrued interest and net lease investments, unlike broader portfolios; match only to the corresponding allowance and net measure.

children.label: Financing receivables net of allowance, excluding interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: This net financing receivable excludes accrued interest and lease net investments; it overlaps the supplied gross/allowance bridge and may differ from note receivables including interest.

children.label: Financing credit allowances
children.classification_note: General, interest-excluding and real-estate credit allowances are overlapping portfolio/basis views. Net financing balances already deduct their matching allowance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLosses
concepts.review_reason: The financing-receivable allowance excludes loss-sharing exposures and can include mortgage/note portfolios; do not deduct it from balances already net of allowance.

children.label: Financing Receivable Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate loan reserves can be included in broader financing credit allowances; do not apply them to mortgage balances already net of reserves.

children.label: Loans held for sale
children.classification_note: Gross held-for-sale financing differs from net loans outside a disposal group. These overlap only after matching valuation, loss-sharing and disposal scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleAmount
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-sale financing receivables are before valuation allowance and overlap the supplied net-not-in-disposal-group measure only after scope reconciliation.

children.label: Loans Held for Sale, Net, Outside Disposal Groups

concepts.name: us-gaap:LoansReceivableHeldForSaleNetNotPartOfDisposalGroup
concepts.review_reason: This held-for-sale financing amount is after valuation allowance and excludes disposal groups, loss-sharing loans and debt-security investments; it is not interchangeable with the generic gross held-for-sale tag.

children.label: Servicing assets
children.classification_note: The aggregate includes fair-value and amortization methods; the fair-value servicing amount may already be included.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ServicingAsset
concepts.review_reason: The servicing asset aggregate includes both fair-value and amortization methods and overlaps the supplied fair-value servicing position.

children.label: Servicing assets measured at fair value

concepts.name: us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueAmount
concepts.review_reason: The servicing asset fair-value amount can overlap the aggregate servicing asset balance containing both fair-value and amortization methods.

children.label: Securities and other investments
children.classification_note: All-investment, maturity, liquidity and instrument classifications overlap. Carrying values and supplemental fair-value disclosures are kept distinct.

children.label: Aggregate and maturity views
children.classification_note: All investments can include real estate, loans and joint ventures. Current short-term and marketable categories can contain the separately mapped security portfolios.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Investments
concepts.review_reason: All investments may include real estate, loans, securities and joint ventures measured differently; reconcile the issuer aggregate before using detail.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Debt securities combine AFS, HTM and trading portfolios on different measurement bases and overlap their separate balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Current short-term investments can contain AFS, HTM, trading and other portfolios separately mapped by security class.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketableSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Marketable securities may include AFS, HTM, trading and FV-NI equity portfolios; do not add this liquidity-based aggregate to its security-class amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Residual other investments may contain joint ventures, loans or alternative securities already classified separately; establish excluded portfolios.

children.label: AFS and HTM debt securities
children.classification_note: AFS is at fair value; HTM is amortized cost before allowance. AFS allowances are not automatically deducted from a fair-value balance and the HTM allowance requires matching scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: AFS credit allowances can be disclosed alongside fair-value AFS balances; confirm carrying treatment rather than deducting an allowance mechanically from an already fair-value asset.

children.label: HTM debt securities before credit allowance

concepts.name: us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecurities
concepts.review_reason: The official HTM carrying amount is before allowance for credit loss; match the separately supplied HTM allowance rather than assuming this amount is net.

children.label: Debt Securities Held To Maturity Allowance For Credit Loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: HTM allowance relates to amortized-cost debt securities and can be included in broader credit-loss disclosures; match only the corresponding pre-allowance HTM portfolio.

children.label: Equity and trading investments
children.classification_note: Current FV-NI is a subset of all-period FV-NI. TradingSecurities includes both trading debt and FV-NI equity; these are overlapping aggregate/detail views.

children.label: Trading debt and FV-NI equity securities

concepts.name: us-gaap:TradingSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Trading securities include trading debt and FV-NI equity under the official definition and therefore overlap both standalone portfolios.

children.label: Current and noncurrent FV-NI equity securities

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Total FV-NI equity securities includes the separately mapped current FV-NI balance; no noncurrent difference is inferred without matching scopes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNi
concepts.review_reason: The official FV-NI equity tag is classified current; it is narrower than the current-and-noncurrent equity security total.

children.label: Other fair-value investment positions
children.classification_note: Owned investments and mortgage/MBS/ABS positions may be recognized balances or overlapping fair-value disclosures; their issuer use must be established.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue
concepts.review_reason: This owned investment measure is at fair value and may be a recognized investment position or disclosure overlapping other portfolios; establish the issuer use before treating it as a separate asset.

children.label: Mortgage, MBS and ABS positions at fair value

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancialInstrumentsOwnedMortgagesMortgageBackedAndAssetBackedSecuritiesAtFairValue
concepts.review_reason: This fair-value mortgage/MBS/ABS position includes pledged and unpledged holdings and can overlap both mortgage and security portfolios; establish whether a recognized balance or disclosure.

children.label: Joint venture and affiliate investments
children.classification_note: These are investments owned by the reporting entity, not noncontrolling partners equity in consolidated subsidiaries. Investee/legal-form categories and measurement methods overlap.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method carrying investments can include the same real-estate joint ventures mapped separately; use a reconciled investee population rather than adding the views.

children.label: Investments In Affiliates Subsidiaries Associates And Joint Ventures

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentsInAffiliatesSubsidiariesAssociatesAndJointVentures
concepts.review_reason: Affiliate/associate/joint-venture investments and advances are broader than equity-method investments and can reflect different entity scopes; reconcile to consolidated presentation.

children.label: Unconsolidated real estate and other joint venture investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentsUnconsolidatedRealEstateAndOtherJointVentures
concepts.review_reason: Unconsolidated real-estate and other joint ventures can overlap both equity-method investments and the broader real-estate joint-venture tag.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateInvestmentsJointVentures
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate joint ventures can overlap the unconsolidated-joint-venture and equity-method asset views; identify consolidation and investee scope.

children.label: Derivative asset balances
children.classification_note: DerivativeAssets is after master netting; the before-netting tag excludes assets outside master agreements. Interest-rate derivatives are an instrument subset, not extra assets.

children.label: Derivative Asset Fair Value, Before Netting

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAsset
concepts.review_reason: This derivative asset measure is before master netting and excludes assets outside master agreements, unlike DerivativeAssets; it cannot substitute for the post-netting balance.

children.label: Interest rate derivative assets at fair value

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestRateDerivativeAssetsAtFairValue
concepts.review_reason: Interest-rate derivative assets are a subset of broader derivative assets and can use different netting scopes; do not add the subset to its aggregate.

children.label: Productive-use property, plant and equipment
children.classification_note: PP&E is not assumed to exclude investment property without issuer support. Combined and component balances overlap; gross and net measurements require matched depreciation.

children.label: PP&E measurements
children.classification_note: Gross and net PP&E are alternatives separated by valuation deductions; do not deduct depreciation twice.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet
concepts.review_reason: PP&E can include investment property depending on issuer presentation; separate owner-used assets only where the source establishes that exclusion.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross PP&E can overlap investment-real-estate totals and productive-use detail; identify the issuer property population before combining.

children.label: Accumulated Depreciation Depletion And Amortization Property Plant And Equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAndAmortizationPropertyPlantAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: PP&E accumulated depreciation/depletion/amortization can include investment-property depreciation; match asset scope and do not deduct from net PP&E.

children.label: Productive-use land
children.classification_note: Land-plus-improvements contains standalone land and land improvements; investment or held-for-sale land may require a different scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LandAndLandImprovements
concepts.review_reason: Productive-use land plus improvements overlaps standalone land and land improvements and may overlap investment property; do not add all three views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LandImprovements
concepts.review_reason: Productive-use land improvements are included in the combined land-and-improvement balance and can overlap investment property components.

children.label: Productive-use buildings, construction and equipment
children.classification_note: Building, construction, fixture/equipment and furniture/fixture classes can overlap investment-property and combined PP&E populations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BuildingsAndImprovementsGross
concepts.review_reason: Productive-use gross buildings can overlap investment-building disclosures if the issuer reports one combined property population; establish investment versus owner-use scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ConstructionInProgressGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross construction in progress may contain investment-property development already mapped as DevelopmentInProcess; reconcile asset classes before summing.

children.label: Goodwill and intangible assets
children.classification_note: Goodwill-inclusive, goodwill-excluding and finite-lived balances overlap acquired lease assets. Gross and net intangibles are alternatives and accumulated amortization is already deducted in net amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IntangibleAssetsNetIncludingGoodwill
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill-inclusive net intangibles already include goodwill and other intangible assets and cannot be added to those components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IntangibleAssetsNetExcludingGoodwill
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill-excluding intangibles include both finite- and indefinite-lived assets and specified software; they overlap standalone finite-lived and lease-related intangibles.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherIntangibleAssetsNet
concepts.review_reason: Other net intangibles may be included in goodwill-excluding or finite-lived totals; identify exclusions for acquired leases.

children.label: Prepaids, deferred costs and other assets
children.classification_note: Combined prepaid/deferred/other aggregates overlap their individual components and maturity views. Debt issuance cost presentation is separately subject to issuer review.

children.label: Prepaid and combined asset views
children.classification_note: Current prepaids and other assets are subsets of all-period aggregates. No difference is automatically classified noncurrent.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Prepaids plus other assets combines categories separately mapped as prepaids and other assets; select an aggregate or reconciled components.

children.label: Prepaid expense and other assets current

concepts.name: us-gaap:PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current prepaids plus other assets combine categories also mapped separately and are a subset of the all-period prepaid/other aggregate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PrepaidExpenseCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current prepaids are a subset of all-period prepaids and can be included in prepaid-plus-other-current assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCostsAndOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Deferred costs plus other assets overlaps separately mapped deferred costs, prepaids and other asset balances; select a reconciled aggregate or components.

children.label: Deferred cost balances
children.classification_note: All-period deferred costs, noncurrent costs excluding customer contracts and other net deferred costs have different included classes; lease and finance costs may overlap.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCostsCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Deferred costs across current/noncurrent periods can include leasing, financing and other deferred-cost details; reconcile scope and presentation before addition.

children.label: Noncurrent deferred costs excluding customer contract costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCosts
concepts.review_reason: The official DeferredCosts tag is noncurrent and excludes capitalized customer-contract costs; it is not an all-period deferred-cost total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherDeferredCostsNet
concepts.review_reason: Other net deferred costs exclude finance and insurance acquisition costs but can include leasing costs; establish residual exclusions.

children.label: Debt issuance cost asset candidates
children.classification_note: Debt issuance costs may be debt deductions rather than separate assets. Credit-line cost treatment and noncurrent net subsets require arrangement-specific review.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsNet
concepts.review_reason: Net debt issuance costs can be presented as an asset or a deduction from debt depending on the financing arrangement; asset placement requires issuer presentation review.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsNoncurrentNet
concepts.review_reason: Net noncurrent finance costs are a maturity subset of deferred finance costs and require asset-versus-debt-deduction presentation review.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnamortizedDebtIssuanceExpense
concepts.review_reason: Unamortized issuance expense may be a debt deduction rather than an asset and can overlap net deferred finance costs; verify presentation and instrument scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtIssuanceCostsLineOfCreditArrangementsNet
concepts.review_reason: Net credit-line issuance costs may qualify for asset presentation but can overlap broader deferred finance costs; establish financing arrangement and issuer scope.

children.label: Other asset balances
children.classification_note: OtherAssets contains maturity/residual views and can contain separately mapped prepaid, deferred, escrow and servicing assets; match issuer exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssetsCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other current assets are a subset of OtherAssets and can overlap prepaid-plus-other-current assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssetsNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other noncurrent assets are a maturity subset of OtherAssets and can include separately disclosed deferred costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssetsMiscellaneous
concepts.review_reason: Miscellaneous other assets may be included in OtherAssets or prepaid/deferred aggregates; confirm its residual exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InventoryNet
concepts.review_reason: Inventory can include property developed for sale rather than investment real estate; verify issuer asset class and avoid duplicating land or development holdings.

children.label: Tax assets
children.classification_note: Deferred tax assets are net after valuation allowances and jurisdictional offsets. Current income-tax refunds are separate from deferred taxes.

children.label: Reported current asset subtotal
children.classification_note: This explicit classified subtotal is included in total assets; the remainder of the hierarchy does not impose maturity on unspecified concepts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetsCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current assets are a maturity subset of total assets; use the reported classified subtotal without imposing maturity on unspecified tags.

children.label: Debt obligations
children.classification_note: Debt aggregate, maturity, collateral, priority and instrument views overlap. Amounts already net of debt discount and issuance costs are not reduced a second time.

children.label: Reported debt aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: Debt-and-lease obligations include leases while other supplied debt totals exclude them or require scope review. Do not add standalone lease balances to an already lease-inclusive total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations
concepts.review_reason: The official definition includes short/long-term debt and lease obligations; it is broader than debt excluding leases and must not be combined with standalone lease liabilities.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombinedAmount
concepts.review_reason: Combined short/long-term debt overlaps net long-term debt and other instrument-based balances; determine lease exclusions before comparing with debt-and-lease obligations.

children.label: Long-term debt maturity views
children.classification_note: Current and noncurrent long-term debt are contained in LongTermDebt and exclude lease obligations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LongTermDebtCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current maturities of long-term debt are included in LongTermDebt and the combined debt total; do not add the subtotal to the full obligation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent long-term debt excludes the current portion and leases and is included in full LongTermDebt; do not add both carrying scopes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other long-term debt can be included in long-term debt and residual note or loan amounts; identify instrument exclusions.

children.label: Secured, unsecured and senior debt views
children.classification_note: Secured/noncurrent secured, unsecured and senior notes classify the same debt on different axes. They can overlap note and loan groups.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SecuredDebt
concepts.review_reason: Secured debt spans current and noncurrent portions of originally long-term borrowing; it overlaps maturity and seniority views and the noncurrent secured tag.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SecuredLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Secured long-term debt excludes its current portion and is contained in all-period secured debt and noncurrent long-term debt views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnsecuredDebt
concepts.review_reason: Unsecured debt includes current and noncurrent portions of originally long-term obligations and overlaps all-debt, note and maturity views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SeniorNotes
concepts.review_reason: Senior notes describe priority within originally long-term notes and can be secured, unsecured or convertible; reconcile to note and total debt balances.

children.label: Notes, loans and convertible obligations
children.classification_note: Notes-and-loans combines note and loan balances. Convertible notes can be part of both convertible debt and notes payable; bank loans and other notes are narrower subsets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NotesAndLoansPayable
concepts.review_reason: Notes-and-loans payable combine obligations separately mapped as notes and loans and can overlap total long-term debt across maturities.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NotesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Notes payable include current and noncurrent portions of originally long-term notes and can be contained in notes-and-loans, senior or convertible debt views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LoansPayableToBank
concepts.review_reason: Bank loans include both current and noncurrent portions of originally long-term borrowing and can be contained in loans or notes-and-loans payable.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNotesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Other notes payable are long-term by definition and may be included in OtherLongTermDebt or broader NotesPayable.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ConvertibleDebt
concepts.review_reason: Convertible debt includes current/noncurrent portions of originally long-term instruments and may include convertible notes; reconcile the broader/narrower instrument coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ConvertibleNotesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Convertible notes may be included in broader convertible debt, notes payable and long-term debt; identify the same instrument once.

children.label: Drawn credit-line obligations
children.classification_note: These are outstanding obligations rather than unused commitments. Current credit-line obligations are included in the all-period line amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LineOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: This drawn line-of-credit carrying amount includes current and noncurrent portions and is not unused facility capacity; reconcile its current subset and total debt inclusion.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LinesOfCreditCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current credit-line obligations are included in the all-period drawn line balance and broader current debt where reported.

children.label: Repurchase financing
children.classification_note: Post-netting securities repos, secured repo borrowing and significant repurchase liabilities may differ in netting and accrued-interest basis; select a reconciled carrying view.

children.label: Securities Sold Under Agreements To Repurchase

concepts.name: us-gaap:SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchase
concepts.review_reason: Securities repo debt is after master netting and can overlap secured repo or significant repurchase-liability disclosures with different netting/accrual scopes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SecuredDebtRepurchaseAgreements
concepts.review_reason: Secured repo borrowing can overlap securities repo liabilities; reconcile master netting and principal/accrued-interest treatment before choosing a carrying amount.

children.label: Significant repurchase liability including accrued interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseRepurchaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: This repurchase liability includes accrued interest and applies to significant repurchase positions; it need not equal the broader post-netting securities repo balance.

children.label: Lessee lease liabilities
children.classification_note: These lease obligations are distinct from lessor rent deferrals and tenant deposits. Total/maturity views overlap and can already be included in debt-and-lease aggregates.

children.label: Operating lease liability views
children.classification_note: Current and noncurrent amounts are subsets of the total operating lease liability.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLiabilityCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current operating lease liabilities are included in total operating lease liabilities; no extra lease debt is created by presenting this maturity subset.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent operating lease liabilities are contained in the all-period operating lease amount; reconcile the same portfolio with its current subset.

children.label: Finance lease liability views
children.classification_note: Noncurrent finance lease liability is included in the total; a current balance is not inferred from unmatched facts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinanceLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent finance-lease liability is included in total finance-lease liability; do not add the maturity subset to its total.

children.label: Rental deposits and deferred income
children.classification_note: Advance rent, security deposits, deferred rent and customer contracts have different recognition scopes but may be included in broader deferred-revenue or liability totals.

children.label: Tenant and customer funding liabilities
children.classification_note: Refundable security/customer deposits differ from advance rent recognized over the lease term; identify overlap and lease-versus-customer accounting scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CustomerAdvancesAndDeposits
concepts.review_reason: Refundable customer advances/deposits can overlap security deposits or other liabilities; distinguish them from earned-rent deferrals and customer performance obligations.

children.label: Deferred revenue and customer obligations
children.classification_note: Customer contract liabilities are not automatic proxies for lease deferrals. Current customer and deferred-revenue amounts are subsets of their all-period totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredRevenue
concepts.review_reason: Deferred revenue is broader than customer contract liabilities and can include deferred rental income; reconcile its current subset and advance-rent or deferred-rent details.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredRevenueCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current deferred revenue is a maturity subset of total deferred revenue and can include current customer contract liabilities.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiability
concepts.review_reason: Customer contract liabilities exclude lease obligations under their own accounting scope; reconcile inclusion in deferred revenue rather than treating all advance rent as customer revenue.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current customer contract liabilities are included in the all-period customer balance and may also be contained in current deferred revenue.

children.label: Acquired lease liabilities and candidates
children.classification_note: Unfavorable off-market lease liabilities and net below-market lease amounts depend on entity role and acquired contract terms. Amortization is a valuation disclosure, not an extra payable.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OffMarketLeaseUnfavorable
concepts.review_reason: Unfavorable off-market leases establish a liability but may overlap below-market lease balances; confirm contractual role and included acquired lease population.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseNet
concepts.review_reason: The below-market acquired-lease balance does not alone establish the reporting entity as lessor or lessee; liability placement is provisional pending lease role and issuer presentation.

children.label: Other property income deferrals
children.classification_note: Deferred rent credit is contractual rent above recognized income. Deferred gain on property sales is an unrecognized gain balance, not the property sale proceeds.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredRentCredit
concepts.review_reason: Deferred rent credit is required rent above recognized rental income and may be included in deferred revenue; it is not the same as tenant security deposits.

children.label: Payables and accrued obligations
children.classification_note: Combined accounts payable/accruals, residual liability totals and their trade/natural/maturity details overlap; group membership never establishes an additive bridge.

children.label: Combined payable and accrued liability views
children.classification_note: All-period combined payables/accruals overlap current combined balances, payables-plus-other-accruals and accrued-plus-other-liability alternatives.

children.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current and Noncurrent
Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current payables/accruals are included in the all-period combined balance and overlap separate current trade payables, taxes and accruals.

children.label: Accounts payable and other accrued liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsPayableAndOtherAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: This payables-plus-other-accruals aggregate differs from all accrued liabilities; reconcile its residual accrual scope to the broader combined payable total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Accrued plus other liabilities overlaps standalone accruals and other-liability residuals; select the issuer aggregate or reconciled components.

children.label: Other current accounts payable and accruals

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: This other-payables-and-accruals tag is explicitly current despite lacking Current in its name; reconcile it to the current combined payable aggregate.

children.label: Trade payables
children.classification_note: Current trade accounts payable are included in the all-period trade payable amount; construction obligations are separately identified by definition but can be included in broader aggregates.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ConstructionPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Construction payables exclude trade payables under the definition but may be included in broader combined liabilities; identify the issuer aggregate coverage.

children.label: Accrued and residual obligations
children.classification_note: Current and all-period accruals and other accruals are nested or overlapping scopes. Invoiced trade payables differ from accrued expenses.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Accrued liabilities exclude invoiced trade payables and can be included in combined payable/accrued totals; reconcile with other-liability residuals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccruedLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current accrued liabilities are included in all-period accruals and current combined payables/accruals; select matching reporting scopes.

children.label: Other accrued liabilities current and noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other accrued liabilities across maturities can be contained in all accrued liabilities and combined payable/accrual totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current other accruals are included in all-period other accruals and current accrued totals; do not add all residual views.

children.label: Interest, dividends and management fees payable
children.classification_note: Current interest is a subset of all-period interest and can be included in broader accruals. Dividends declared but unpaid differ from cumulative distributions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestPayableCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current interest payable is contained in the all-period interest payable amount and may be included in accrued liability totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ManagementFeePayable
concepts.review_reason: Management fees payable can be included in trade or accrued payables and may involve affiliates; identify the issuer residual scope.

children.label: Employee and deferred compensation obligations
children.classification_note: Current employee liabilities are included in all-period employee liabilities, while deferred compensation can overlap employee or other accrued totals.

children.label: Employee related liabilities current and noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Employee-related liabilities overlap broader accrued liabilities and contain the separately mapped current employee obligations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current employee obligations are contained in the all-period employee liability total and broader current accruals.

children.label: Deferred Compensation Liability Current And Noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredCompensationLiabilityCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Deferred compensation liabilities may be included in employee-related or other accrued liabilities; reconcile arrangement scope.

children.label: Tax liabilities
children.classification_note: All-tax payable includes income and property tax subsets. Deferred tax liabilities are jurisdictionally netted balances and differ from current tax accruals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TaxesPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: All-tax payables include income and property taxes separately mapped; select a total or matched components.

children.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Current and Noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccruedIncomeTaxes
concepts.review_reason: Accrued income taxes include current and noncurrent obligations and may be contained in all-tax payable totals.

children.label: Property and other nonincome taxes payable

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccrualForTaxesOtherThanIncomeTaxesCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: This tax accrual specifically covers real/property taxes and may be included in all-tax or general accrued liabilities.

children.label: Derivative and credit exposure liabilities
children.classification_note: Interest-rate derivatives can be included in post-netting derivative liabilities. Off-balance-sheet credit-loss provision is a recognized liability with scope excluding derivatives and insurance.

children.label: Interest rate derivative liabilities at fair value

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestRateDerivativeLiabilitiesAtFairValue
concepts.review_reason: Interest-rate derivative liabilities are an instrument subset of broader derivative liabilities; confirm netting and offsetting before using both.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiability
concepts.review_reason: The expected off-balance-sheet credit-loss liability excludes insurance and derivative exposures and can be included in other liabilities; it is a recognized liability, not a loan asset allowance.

children.label: Other liability balances
children.classification_note: Current/noncurrent other liabilities are subsets of OtherLiabilities and may contain identified contingent consideration, retirement, tax and deferred amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other current liabilities are a subset of OtherLiabilities and can contain separately mapped current accrual or deferred revenue amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherLiabilitiesNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other noncurrent liabilities are included in OtherLiabilities and can contain deferred rental or lease amounts separately mapped.

children.label: Disposal-group liabilities
children.classification_note: Current, noncurrent and other disposal liabilities are included in the all-period total and need not all relate to discontinued operations.

children.label: Liabilities Of Disposal Group Including Discontinued Operation
Liabilities of disposal group including discontinued operation current

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilitiesOfDisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current disposal-group liabilities are contained in all-period disposal obligations and are not additional to that aggregate.

children.label: Liabilities of disposal group including discontinued operation noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilitiesOfDisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent disposal-group liabilities are included in all-period disposal obligations; retain the explicit maturity without inferring it elsewhere.

children.label: Disposal group including discontinued operation other liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationOtherLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other disposal-group liabilities are a subset of disposal-group obligations, not an additional liability alongside the total.

children.label: Reported current liability subtotal
children.classification_note: Current liabilities are a reported subset of all liabilities; no automatic maturity allocation is imposed elsewhere.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current liabilities are included in total liabilities; no noncurrent residual or maturity allocation of other tags is inferred.

children.label: Common stock and contributed capital
children.classification_note: Issued common value includes treasury shares, while outstanding value excludes them. Common-only APIC is contained in total APIC.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockValueOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding common share value excludes treasury shares, unlike issued common par/stated value; reconcile with treasury presentation without adding both common balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapitalCommonStock
concepts.review_reason: Common-stock APIC is included in all-stock APIC; use the reported equity scope without adding both.

children.label: Preferred equity carrying amounts
children.classification_note: Permanent-equity placement requires redemption-term review. Issued and outstanding preferred values differ in treasury-share inclusion.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValue
concepts.review_reason: Issued preferred par/stated value includes treasury shares; review redemption terms for permanent-equity eligibility and distinguish outstanding preferred value.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValueOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding preferred value excludes treasury shares, unlike issued preferred value; verify redemption terms and reconcile rather than adding both.

children.label: Earnings and distribution deficit presentations
children.classification_note: Retained earnings/deficit and distributions in excess of net income can be alternate presentations of the same accumulated equity position; do not add both blindly.

children.label: Distributions in excess of net income

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccumulatedDistributionsInExcessOfNetIncome
concepts.review_reason: Distributions in excess of net income can be the issuer equity deficit presentation and overlap retained earnings/accumulated deficit; do not record both as separate deductions.

children.label: Treasury stock deductions
children.classification_note: All-class treasury cost contains common treasury cost; select the issuer scope. Contra does not prescribe negating already signed source values.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TreasuryStockValue
concepts.review_reason: All-class treasury cost includes common and possibly preferred treasury shares; it overlaps the separate common treasury stock amount.

children.label: Accumulated comprehensive results
children.classification_note: AOCI is an after-tax accumulated equity position and differs from current-period OCI or its tax effect.

children.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
Noncontrolling equity
children.classification_note: Total NCI excludes temporary equity. Operating partnerships, consolidated joint ventures, other interests and partner-capital views can overlap; these are subsidiary equity, not investee assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MinorityInterestInOperatingPartnerships
concepts.review_reason: Operating-partnership noncontrolling equity can be included in MinorityInterest and partner-capital noncontrolling totals; do not add overlapping ownership views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MinorityInterestInJointVentures
concepts.review_reason: Noncontrolling joint-venture interests concern consolidated investees, not the REIT asset investment in unconsolidated joint ventures; they can be included in total noncontrolling equity.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherMinorityInterests
concepts.review_reason: Other noncontrolling equity excludes joint ventures, limited/operating partnerships and preferred units but can be included in total noncontrolling interests.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PartnersCapitalAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
concepts.review_reason: Noncontrolling partner capital can include operating or joint-venture partnership equity already mapped under more specific noncontrolling tags.

nodes.label: Temporary equity and redeemable noncontrolling interests
nodes.classification_note: Parent, consolidated and redeemable-noncontrolling totals overlap; common/preferred redeemable NCI are subsets. Confirm terms before choosing temporary equity versus liability classification.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterests
concepts.review_reason: Total temporary equity includes parent and noncontrolling interests and overlaps the separate parent and redeemable-noncontrolling balances; it is outside permanent equity.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountAttributableToParent
concepts.review_reason: Parent-attributable temporary equity is contained in the parent-plus-noncontrolling total; verify redemption terms and select attribution scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCarryingAmount
concepts.review_reason: Redeemable noncontrolling carrying value spans all equity forms and may be included in total temporary equity; verify redemption classification and avoid adding preferred/common subsets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityPreferredCarryingAmount
concepts.review_reason: Redeemable preferred noncontrolling interests are a subset of all redeemable noncontrolling carrying value; verify temporary equity versus liability classification.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCommonCarryingAmount
concepts.review_reason: Redeemable common noncontrolling carrying value is included in the all-redeemable-noncontrolling amount and can also be included in total temporary equity.

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Nonmonetary counts/rates, fair-value alternatives, contractual amounts, schedule figures and unresolved classification candidates are kept outside primary carrying balances.

children.label: Share and partnership unit counts
children.classification_note: Shares/units are instant counts, not monetary balances. Issued includes treasury where applicable; outstanding excludes treasury. Partner units are not automatically common shares.

children.label: Common share counts
children.classification_note: Authorized, issued, outstanding and treasury shares describe different populations and must not be added.

children.label: Preferred share counts
children.classification_note: These counts refer to nonredeemable or issuer-option-redeemable preferred shares; they do not settle the classification of other preferred instruments.

children.label: Temporary equity share counts
children.classification_note: Temporary equity counts relate to instruments outside permanent equity and exclude mandatorily redeemable liability-classified shares under the definition.

children.label: Partnership unit counts
children.classification_note: Limited and general partner counts can have different economic and conversion rights and are not equivalent to REIT common shares.

children.label: Limited partners capital account units outstanding
Per-share, rate and ownership disclosures
children.classification_note: Par, redemption price, liquidation preference, dividend rate and VIE ownership are different measures; rates retain their taxonomy duration period.

children.label: Par and redemption price per share
children.classification_note: Per-share par and contractual redemption values are not monetary carrying amounts. Preferred liquidation preference here is excess over par, not full proceeds.

children.label: Common Stock Par or Stated Value per Share
Preferred Stock Par or Stated Value per Share
Temporary equity par or stated value per share
Preferred liquidation preference excess per share
Preferred stock redemption price per share
Duration percentage disclosures
children.classification_note: Official taxonomy assigns duration to preferred dividend rate and VIE ownership percentage; no instant metadata is substituted based on the BS context.

children.label: Fair-value and alternative measurement disclosures
children.classification_note: Fair values of amortized-cost assets/debt and historical cost of fair-value assets are supplemental measurements, not extra carrying amounts.

children.label: Security and investee measurements
children.classification_note: AFS amortized cost and HTM fair value describe alternative bases. Broad investment fair values and MBS or equity-method fair values can overlap their carrying portfolios.

children.label: AFS mortgage-backed securities fair value disclosure
Loan and debt fair values
children.classification_note: Note, loan, mortgage-held-for-sale and debt fair values overlap instrument populations but differ from carrying values and gross/net valuation scope.

children.label: Loans Held For Sale Fair Value Disclosure
Mortgages Held For Sale Fair Value Disclosure
Net derivative presentation
children.classification_note: This net asset/liability measure does not establish separate gross asset and liability recognition or a universal balance-sheet side.

children.label: Net derivative asset or liability position

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeAssetsLiabilitiesAtFairValueNet
concepts.review_reason: A net derivative asset/liability amount can combine opposite positions; retain it as a supplemental net presentation rather than assigning all of it to assets or liabilities.

children.label: SEC Schedule III property disclosure
children.classification_note: Schedule III property scope can differ from the primary balance sheet; retain as a supplemental reconciliation basis rather than an extra asset.

children.label: SEC Schedule III net investment property

concepts.name: us-gaap:SECScheduleIIIRealEstateInvestmentPropertyNet
concepts.review_reason: SEC Schedule III net property is a schedule reporting scope that may overlap primary net investment property; reconcile schedule exclusions rather than using it as an extra asset.

children.label: Gross financing cost measurement
children.classification_note: Gross debt issuance costs are before amortization and may relate to debt deductions rather than separately recognized assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross finance costs are not the same as a net debt-cost asset and may be included in debt carrying-value deductions; retain as a measurement disclosure.

children.label: Debt carrying-value adjustments
children.classification_note: Unamortized discounts and combined discount/premium/issuance cost balances are already reflected in applicable net debt carrying values; no second deduction or universal sign is prescribed.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscount
concepts.review_reason: Unamortized debt discount is already reflected in net debt carrying amounts and can be included in the combined discount/premium/issuance-cost adjustment.

children.label: Unamortized debt discount, premium and issuance costs, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountPremiumAndDebtIssuanceCostsNet
concepts.review_reason: This combined unamortized discount/premium and issuance-cost adjustment is already reflected in net debt and can have either discount or premium direction; no universal contra sign is inferred.

children.label: Acquired lease amortization disclosure
children.classification_note: The below-market lease amortization balance must follow the verified asset/liability role and corresponding gross amount, rather than being added to net acquired lease balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BelowMarketLeaseAccumulatedAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Below-market lease accumulated amortization relates to the separately supplied net lease amount; identify asset/liability orientation and do not amortize an already net balance again.

children.label: Redemption and liquidation contract amounts
children.classification_note: Aggregate liquidation excess, contractual redemption amounts and settlement values are not automatically the recognized permanent-equity, temporary-equity or liability carrying balance.

children.label: Preferred liquidation preference excess over par
Currently redeemable preferred contractual redemption amount

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockRedemptionAmount
concepts.review_reason: Currently redeemable preferred redemption amount can include unpaid/undeclared dividends; it is a contractual amount rather than a substitute for carrying equity.

children.label: Contractual settlement amount for redeemable shares

concepts.name: us-gaap:SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsAmount
concepts.review_reason: The contractual amount payable on redemption is not necessarily the recognized liability or temporary-equity carrying amount; review settlement terms before balance-sheet classification.

children.label: Collateral and commitments
children.classification_note: Pledged assets remain included in recognized asset portfolios; commitments captions do not create recognized liabilities without an applicable measurement.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCollateralAmount
concepts.review_reason: Pledged collateral is an exposure/security disclosure and remains included in the relevant recognized assets; it is not an extra asset or debt carrying value.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommitmentsAndContingencies
concepts.review_reason: This commitments/contingencies caption does not establish a single recognized liability amount; retain the disclosure separately from booked obligations.

children.label: Acquisition and distribution history
children.classification_note: Acquisition-date intangible recognition and cumulative dividends distributed are historical measurement disclosures, not period-end net intangibles or dividends payable.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiableAssetsAcquiredAndLiabilitiesAssumedIntangibleAssetsOtherThanGoodwill
concepts.review_reason: This acquisition-date recognized intangible amount is not necessarily the reporting-date net intangible balance; retain it as an acquisition measurement disclosure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CumulativeDividends
concepts.review_reason: Cumulative cash dividends distributed are a historical distribution measure, not dividends payable or an additional equity deficit amount.

children.label: Net assets and classification candidates
children.classification_note: Net assets and an ambiguous construction loan require issuer scope/role review; neither is automatically substituted for permanent equity, a mortgage receivable or borrowing.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetsNet
concepts.review_reason: Net assets can be an analytical or entity-specific presentation and do not automatically equal the parent or consolidated stockholders equity concept.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ConstructionLoan
concepts.review_reason: The construction loan tag describes short-term real-estate financing but does not establish lender versus borrower presentation; retain outside primary asset/liability sections pending issuer context.
